purpose: Add an app-owned mapped-candidate same-input output comparator that reads a Goal5339 command packet after execution, compares author and RTDL HDResult, and keeps timing fields separated without reporting a performance ratio.

inputs: Goal5339 mapped-candidate same-input gate packet JSON
author hd_exec JSON outputs produced by a later POD gate
RTDL hd_exec-compatible JSON outputs produced by a later POD gate

behavior_locked_by_tests: matching outputs pass without performance ratio
packet not command-ready fails the gate

pod_usage.reason: This goal adds the post-POD comparator only. It does not execute the command packet.

allowed_summary: Goal5340 adds an app-owned post-execution comparator for future mapped-candidate same-input POD outputs. It compares HDResult and keeps timing fields separated without reporting a performance ratio.
not_allowed: claiming commands were executed by this comparator
claiming exact paper dataset reproduction from an HDResult match alone
claiming Figure 5 reproduction from this comparison alone
claiming full X-HD paper reproduction from this comparison alone
claiming author-vs-RTDL performance ratio from this comparison
